snapshot.scope: Review the fixed canonical manual-update download action, strict renderer/Main boundary, unavailable automatic-update truth, and exact PIGE-REL-001 evidence without implying release readiness.

reviewers.task: Review canonical manual update download workflow
reviewers.independence: Project review checks the fixed release origin, strict public contract, renderer single-flight behavior and partial acceptance evidence separately from implementation authorship.

dimensions.summary: System Settings replaces a dead control with one fixed canonical downloads action; completion and failure restore the initiating focus.
Schema, contract, preload, Main service and Settings bind the same URL-free request and opened, busy or failed result.
PIGE-REL-001 cites the exact user workflow test while downloaded ZIP, notes and publication report remain explicitly open.
The new action opens only the repository-controlled Releases page and does not widen check, download or apply authority.
Existing release, API, UI and acceptance owners capture the behavior without a new design document.

verification.evidence: Direct service, UI and contract tests prove the fixed origin, strict URL-free boundary, single-flight behavior and retryable failure retention.

verification.command: npm run typecheck && npm run verify:architecture-reset
verification.evidence: The rebased candidate remains type-safe and within protected owner budgets.

verification.command: npm run verify:independent-documentation-review && npm run verify:traceability
verification.evidence: Current release owner docs, exact evidence selector and partial semantic claim remain structurally and executable-current.

coordination.taskTitle: Open canonical manual update downloads from Settings
coordination.compatibility: Existing no-network update check, download and apply behavior remains unchanged; the renderer receives no URL or release authority.
coordination.acknowledgement: The user-visible manual download workflow is bound while final downloaded artifact and publication proof remain open.
